result.evidence_interpretation: On VALID, the native model achieved CE .629858 and positive39 Macro-F1 .516474. PRE-normalization mixing gave .633529/.480549 and POST-normalization averaging gave .632976/.482492. Both missed all declared improvement criteria despite decreasing training CE. That closes the tested mixture profile. The earlier L4 weight/value alignment result motivates examining values, but gives no evidence of measurement savings. The missing observable is the number of overlap shots needed to certify the native 40-way decision at a fixed error allowance and comparable decision coverage.
result.one_next_hypothesis: Run one paired, label-blind shot simulation on the frozen native checkpoint. Test whether sampling tokens in proportion to their value leverage around a proposed decision threshold reduces the cost of certifying the exact native argmax. This is a necessary utility test for this particular readout proposal. There is no credible L5 nomination yet.
result.why_distinct: Both arms use the same native preparation, effects, values, bias, decision certificate and stopping rule. Both can stop measuring a relation once its comparison is resolved. The sole intervention is which token receives the next shot within that relation. Beating this control would isolate a benefit from value-aware allocation beyond the benefit of asking only for a decision.
result.theory_with_assumptions_and_unresolved_g: For a score threshold s, set a_t=b_r+u_rt−s. The native denominator is strictly positive, so the sign of logit_r−s equals the sign of C_r=mean_t[a_t(p_rt+EPS)] over valid tokens. For t sampled from q and an independent overlap bit B with mean p_rt, X=a_t B/(T q_t) estimates the stochastic part of C_r without bias. Add EPS·mean_t(a_t) exactly. Choosing q_t proportional to |a_t| minimizes the worst-case absolute single-shot contribution, since max_t |a_t|/(T q_t) is at least mean_t|a_t|, with equality at that allocation. Zero coefficients need no shots. This deduction gives neither a variance optimum at the actual overlaps nor a stopping-time advantage. The task-linked hypothesis is that large value deviations occur sparsely enough, and on decision-relevant comparisons often enough, to reduce total shots.
result.nearest_collision_risk: The threshold transform is standard fractional programming algebra. The allocation is standard importance sampling for a bounded integrand, and the certificate is sequential threshold identification. The cited fidelity-attention architectures are close on the predictor side. Even a positive result leaves substantive distinction from classical decision-aware Monte Carlo and best-arm identification unresolved.

minimal_test.cohort_and_budget: Use the first 128 official VALID examples in source order, seed-13 native checkpoint, all 40 classes and all valid tokens. Use one fixed simulation stream specification, no training or TEST access. Budget 64 uniform pilot shots plus at most 1,024 fresh confirmation shots per relation per arm, under 11.2 million simulated shots total counting the shared pilot twice.
minimal_test.intervention_and_control: Share pilot observations. Estimate native scores with the uniform-shot plug-in ratio including EPS, choose the pilot winner with source-index tie breaking, and freeze s halfway between the two largest estimated scores. The intervention uses q proportional to |a_t|. The control uses uniform valid-token q. Supply exact overlaps only to the Bernoulli simulator and final decision grader. Charge each arm the full pilot. Count every attempted overlap shot.
minimal_test.certificate: At confirmation counts 32, 64, 128, 256, 512 and 1,024, apply the same two-sided fixed-sample empirical Bernstein interval to X in each arm using its known support range, then add the exact EPS term. Allocate .01/(40×6) error per interval within each arm and sentence. Conditional on the pilot, a union bound covers all looks and relations, including optional stopping. Resolve a relation when its interval lies strictly on the required side of zero. Certify only when the pilot winner is above s and every rival is below it. Handle identically zero coefficients exactly. A wrong pilot winner or poorly placed threshold can cause abstention. The .01 bound applies to the unconditional probability of issuing a wrong decision per sentence.
minimal_test.pass_and_kill: Predeclare passage only if both arms certify at least 103/128 cases, intervention coverage equals or exceeds control coverage, every issued decision matches the independently computed native argmax, and intervention total charged shots are at most 80% of control. Charge every abstention the full per-sentence cap for this comparison so early abandonment earns no savings. A valid run missing any gate closes this allocation profile. An invalid Bernoulli simulation, arithmetic failure or mismatch between the exact contrast sign and source logit comparison invalidates the run and yields no scientific negative.

result.strongest_counterexample: A few tokens can have extreme values and negligible overlap while many moderate-value tokens carry the evidence separating the top two relations. Absolute-value sampling then spends shots on almost certain zeros. It can reduce the maximum contribution yet increase variance and cost on the comparison that determines stopping. Small mean overlap also makes the contrast tiny even at a meaningful logit margin.
result.claim_ceiling: Passage would establish a fixed-cohort simulated shot reduction for preserving decisions of the same native core against a matched sequential control. Each shot assumes a fresh independent Bernoulli overlap measurement for a selected token/effect pair, with classical values already available. Hardware cost would additionally include feature access, proposal construction, repeated state and effect circuit preparation, gates, measurement and readout. The test establishes neither hardware speedup, predictive gain, quantum necessity nor L5 novelty.
